types.homonym_multi_state: measured: the term names gazetteer entries in more than one state

types.short_token: measured: 4 letters or fewer once normalised; high false-positive risk in free text

meta.derivedForms: Rule-made forms (Municipio X, Mcpio. X, Edo. X, Pto. X, Cdad. X, Sta. X) are not listed; they inherit the ambiguity of X restricted to that kind.
